title: Accelerating Rare Disease Patient Recruitment
business: A patient advocacy group focused on rare neurological disorders.
problem: The group struggles to manually cross-reference emerging clinical trial eligibility criteria against their patient registry, leading to missed enrollment opportunities for time-sensitive studies.
solution: By integrating the Clinical Trials connector, the group enables Claude to programmatically query ClinicalTrials.gov using specific patient profile parameters, automatically filtering active studies that match the registry's inclusion criteria.
steps: Configure the Clinical Trials connector using the provided MCP endpoint to establish a secure link to ClinicalTrials.gov.
Define the patient registry's core clinical attributes as structured input parameters for the Claude interface.
Invoke the search_by_eligibility tool to map patient profiles against active trial inclusion and exclusion criteria.
Utilize get_trial_details to extract contact information and site locations for the most relevant matches.
Review the synthesized output to generate targeted outreach summaries for patients.
outcome: The advocacy group gains the ability to rapidly identify and communicate relevant clinical trial opportunities to their patient community, significantly reducing the administrative burden of manual screening.
limitation: The connector relies on the accuracy of data submitted to ClinicalTrials.gov; if a study sponsor provides outdated or incomplete eligibility criteria, the search results may be misleading. Users should verify trial status directly via the provided NCT identifier.
